# gitmoap_ai_models (Data Source)

Every model an organization can use, with its current and announced list prices. The same for every caller, and readable without signing in.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `items` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--items))

<a id="nestedatt--items"></a>
### Nested Schema for `items`

Read-Only:

- `announced_prices` (Attributes List) Prices published to take effect later. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--items--announced_prices))
- `context_window` (Number)
- `current_price` (Attributes) A model's list price in one region, per million tokens, in millionths of a dollar. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--items--current_price))
- `family` (String)
- `max_output` (Number)
- `model_id` (String)
- `provider` (String)
- `provider_model_id` (String)
- `region` (String) Where an organization's model calls are served, and so where its content is processed. Fixed
when the organization is created.
- `retire_at` (String)
- `status` (String)
- `supports_caching` (Boolean)
- `supports_mid_conversation_system` (Boolean)
- `supports_summarized_thinking` (Boolean)
- `tier` (String) A model tier: the most capable, the standard, or the economical model in the organization's
region.
- `tier_default` (Boolean) Whether this is the model its tier routes to in its region. Every other model is used only
when a revision or a persona draft names it.
